neighbours.label: Narrowness or tightness as a meaning, across languages (narrow, étroite, enge/eng, ضيق, сужение, claustrophobic), including figurative senses (a narrow definition, close cooperation), not the opposite meanings wide or spacious.
fire: The lane between the houses was so narrow that two people could not pass.

Die Gasse ist sehr eng und nur zu Fuß erreichbar.
كان الطريق إلى القرية ضيقا ومليئا بالحجارة.
Дорога в горах была узкой и извилистой.
The committee adopted a narrow reading of the rules.
Wir arbeiten eng mit den Schulen der Stadt zusammen.
